{{Top|leg}}
A '''lifeboat bay''' or '''escape pod bay''' was an enclosure on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which held emergency [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and the associated jettison systems.

[[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] colonies in the [[Roche asteroid field]], such as [[Command Base]] and [[Research Station Shantipole]], included lifeboat bays. The [[lifeboat]]s and their launch mechanisms were recessed into the asteroid walls for easy launching.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
